case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Guests frequently praised room quality—spacious, clean rooms, large or new bathrooms, comfortable beds, modern decor, convenient location and free parking—and several reviewers noted pleasant staff and enjoyable breakfasts. Criticisms included limited breakfast choices or skipping breakfast, a noisy in-room device that couldn't be turned off until reception intervened, and a slightly dirty entrance carpet noted by one guest.

review_summary_metadata.summary_method: Neutral LLM summary of the frozen recent review sample; no additional reviews retrieved.

priorities.recommendation: Review breakfast offerings and communication, compare with guest expectations, implement feasible adjustments, and monitor feedback.

priorities.area: In-room equipment/control failure and noise (guest could not turn it off)
priorities.recommendation: Immediately inspect room control systems, prioritize reported rooms, and verify controls function quietly.
Review night-time response procedures for reception/maintenance; consider clarifying SLAs, on-call, logging, and guest notifications.
Initiate immediate commercial review: rates, channels/LOS/ancillaries; convene revenue manager/GM, test adjustments/packages/promotions, monitor costs, consider commissions.
Review menu, portioning, replenishment and guest flow; gather feedback, adjust menu, monitor costs, train staff.

priorities.area: In-room equipment / night noise and guest control
